```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(htmltools)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "futball/futball.db")
rk  <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT team, helyezes FROM nb1_2627_preseason_forecast ORDER BY helyezes")
dbDisconnect(con)

# csapatnév -> logó fájlnév (futball/logos/nb1/<slug>.png vagy .svg)
logo_slug <- c(
  "Ferencváros"           = "ferencvaros",
  "Győri ETO"             = "gyori-eto",
  "Paksi FC"              = "paksi-fc",
  "Puskás FC"             = "puskas-fc",
  "Újpest"                = "ujpest",
  "MTK"                   = "mtk",
  "Debrecen"              = "debrecen",
  "Nyíregyháza Spartacus" = "nyiregyhaza-spartacus",
  "Várda SE"              = "varda-se",
  "Vasas"                 = "vasas",
  "Zalaegerszegi TE"      = "zalaegerszegi-te",
  "Honvéd"                = "honved"
)

initials <- function(name) {
  words <- strsplit(name, " ")[[1]]
  words <- words[!words %in% c("FC", "SE", "TE")]
  toupper(paste(substr(words, 1, 1), collapse = ""))
}

find_logo_ext <- function(slug) {
  for (ext in c("png", "svg")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path("futball", "logos", "nb1", paste0(slug, ".", ext)))) return(ext)
  }
  NA
}

row_html <- function(team, rank) {
  slug <- logo_slug[[team]]
  ext  <- if (!is.null(slug)) find_logo_ext(slug) else NA

  logo_el <- if (!is.na(ext)) {
    tags$img(src = file.path("logos", "nb1", paste0(slug, ".", ext)), alt = team, class = "pr-logo")
  } else {
    tags$div(class = "pr-logo-fallback", initials(team))
  }

  tags$div(class = "pr-row",
    tags$div(class = "pr-rank", rank),
    tags$div(class = "pr-logo-wrap", logo_el),
    tags$div(class = "pr-team", team),
    tags$div(class = "pr-trend", title = "Trend: még nincs korábbi ranking, amihez viszonyítani", "–")
  )
}

tags$div(class = "pr-list",
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(rk)), function(i) row_html(rk$team[i], rk$helyezes[i]))
)
```
